Container.Name: Crema
Container.Overview: Crema is a small Node.js LAN messenger for always-on displays. It serves a PWA, a display view, settings, history, and logs over HTTP.
Container.Description:
Crema runs a peer/PWA Node.js service for sending short LAN messages between devices.
WEB UI: - PWA sender: http://[IP]:[PORT:3000]/ - Display view: http://[IP]:[PORT:3000]/display - Settings: http://[IP]:[PORT:3000]/settings - History: http://[IP]:[PORT:3000]/history - Logs: http://[IP]:[PORT:3000]/logs
DOCKER NETWORKING: Crema's native peer-to-peer mode uses mDNS/.local discovery, which is fragile from Docker. This template runs Crema's lightweight broker inside the same container and points the app at ws://127.0.0.1:4000, so Docker does not need to resolve .local names.
TRANSPORT: The default transport is broker mode. Other Crema peers can use this container as their broker by setting their Broker URL to ws://<unraid-ip>:4000, or to whatever host port you map for the broker.
OTHER PEERS: Crema in broker mode does not discover peers with .local/mDNS. Aurel/Flo/other devices must connect to this broker explicitly: CREMA_TRANSPORT=broker CREMA_BROKER_URL=ws://<unraid-ip>:4000 Use the Unraid server LAN IP here, not 127.0.0.1.
BROKER ADVERTISEMENT: CREMA_BROKER_ADVERTISE=0 disables mDNS advertisement of the broker itself. Keep it disabled for Docker. Set it to 1 only if you deliberately want _crema-broker._tcp mDNS advertisement and your Docker host has working Avahi/mDNS support.
P2P ADDRESS RESOLUTION: When p2p/dual mode is enabled, CREMA_MDNS_RESOLVE_ADDRESSES=1 tells Crema to use IPv4 addresses returned by mDNS instead of depending on .local hostname resolution inside Docker.
PERSISTENCE: Runtime state is stored in /app/data and should be mapped to appdata. This includes replies, shortcuts, Do Not Disturb state, history.db, and event logs.
PERMISSIONS: The container entrypoint fixes ownership of /app/data, then runs Crema as the upstream node user (UID 1000 / GID 1000). This prevents SQLite startup failures when Unraid creates the appdata directory as root on first install.
Container.Changes:
###v1.3.4 (2026-05-21) - Add mDNS address resolution setting for p2p/dual deployments.
###v1.3.3 (2026-05-21) - Clarify broker advertisement and peer setup for Docker broker mode.
###v1.3.2 (2026-05-21) - Keep embedded broker mode broker-only by default to prevent Docker from starting p2p/mDNS discovery.
###v1.3.1 (2026-05-21) - Use a PNG conversion of the upstream SVG icon so the Unraid Docker tab renders it correctly.
###v1.3.0 (2026-05-21) - Use Crema's built-in embedded broker mode from the Docker image. - Remove template-level shell process control.
###v1.2.0 (2026-05-21) - Run Crema's broker inside the same container instead of requiring a separate app. - Switch back to bridge networking and publish both the web and broker ports.
###v1.1.0 (2026-05-21) - Default to broker transport for Docker-friendly networking. - Add a pinned broker URL setting to avoid .local/mDNS resolution inside the container.
###v1.0.1 (2026-05-21) - Fix appdata ownership at startup before running Crema as node.
###v1.0.0 (2026-05-21) - Initial Unraid template release. - Uses the upstream Crema icon from public/icon.svg.

Config.Name: Web/PWA Port
Config.Description: Port used to access the Crema PWA, display, settings, history, and logs.

Config.Name: Embedded Broker Port
Config.Description: Socket.IO broker port. Other Crema peers can connect to ws://<unraid-ip>:[PORT].

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent Crema runtime state: replies, shortcuts, Do Not Disturb state, history database, and event logs.

Config.Name: Owner Name
Config.Description: Display name for this Crema instance. Set a unique owner name for each peer.

Config.Name: Transport
Config.Description: Transport mode: broker, dual, or p2p. Broker is recommended for Docker because it avoids .local/mDNS peer resolution.

Config.Name: Embed Broker
Config.Description: Start Crema's lightweight broker inside this container.

Config.Name: Broker URL
Config.Description: Socket.IO broker URL used by this Crema app. Keep ws://127.0.0.1:4000 to use the embedded broker.

Config.Name: Advertise Broker via mDNS
Config.Description: Advertise this broker as _crema-broker._tcp via mDNS. Keep 0 for Docker and set other peers to ws://<unraid-ip>:4000 explicitly.

Config.Name: Allow P2P with Embedded Broker
Config.Description: Set to 1 only if you want embedded-broker containers to use dual/p2p mDNS discovery. Keep 0 for Docker.

Config.Name: Resolve mDNS Addresses
Config.Description: In p2p/dual mode, prefer IPv4 addresses returned by mDNS over .local hostnames. Set to 0 to use hostname-only mDNS resolution.

Config.Name: Broker Token
Config.Description: Optional shared token. Must match the Crema Broker token when broker authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: Latitude
Config.Description: Latitude used for the display day/night theme schedule.

Config.Name: Longitude
Config.Description: Longitude used for the display day/night theme schedule.
